set.hook: A twelve-seat counter round an open kitchen on the harbour front: the first MICHELIN star Split ever had.
set.why: The old version of this guide said Split had no MICHELIN star. In the 2025 guide Krug became the first: a small room on Obala Ante Trumbića where about a dozen guests sit at a counter facing the open kitchen and watch Karlo Kaleb cook a five- or nine-course menu. Gault&Millau named him its Great Chef of Tomorrow in 2025 and scores the house 16.5/20 in its 2026 review.
set.verdict: The most ambitious cooking in the city, and the most intimate room: a counter, a short and a long menu, and the chef in front of you. Whether the star was kept in the 2026 guide we could not confirm from here; the Gault&Millau 2026 review is current. Book well ahead: there are only about twelve seats.
set.signature: The nine-course menu at the counter.
set.caveat: About twelve seats: book well ahead; hours and the 2026–27 winter schedule not published in what we found, so call.
